mapper.insert: insert into bi_data_form_record (form_id, row_json, success, error_msg, create_by, owner_principal, request_key, payload_hash, submission_status) values (#{formId}, #{rowJson}, #{success}, #{errorMsg}, #{createBy}, #{ownerPrincipal}, #{requestKey}, #{payloadHash}, #{submissionStatus})
mapper.select: select id, form_id, row_json, success, error_msg, create_by, create_time, owner_principal, request_key, payload_hash, submission_status, review_by, review_note, review_time from bi_data_form_record where form_id = #{formId} order by id desc limit 100
